source: Bilibili BV1Gy4y1n7Pv — FitMen六六「無器械健身教程」(17:52)
cycleNote: 影片 15:40:照順序練三天休息一天，循環。
general: 每一下 3–5 秒，慢慢做；目的是刺激肌肉，不是拼速度
下巴微收，頭不要往前伸(會脖子痛)
做不完可減 1–2 組或減少次數，之後再慢慢加回來
general_en: Each rep takes 3–5 seconds. Go slow: the goal is to work the muscle, not to race
Tuck your chin slightly; don't push your head forward (it strains your neck)
Lower-back pain = your abs aren't braced
If you can't finish, drop 1–2 sets or a few reps, then build back up

d1.label: 第 1 天
d1.title: 胸・三頭
d1.after: 練完花 1–2 分鐘伸展胸肌、肱三頭肌
d1.after_en: Afterwards, spend 1–2 minutes stretching your chest and triceps

units.name: 伏地挺身
tips: 身體像平板支撐一樣成一直線，不塌腰不拱背
手臂與身體約 45 度，不要垂直張開
做不了標準版可改跪姿
tips_en: Keep your body in one straight line, like a plank: no sagging, no arching
Keep your arms at about 45° to your body; don't flare them out
If a full push-up is too hard, do it on your knees

units.name: 負重伏地挺身
tips: 背上放書包或其他重物
要點同伏地挺身
tips_en: Put a backpack or something heavy on your back
Same form as the push-up

units.name: 上斜伏地挺身
tips: 雙手撐在凳子、沙發或床邊
要點同伏地挺身
tips_en: Hands on a bench, the sofa or the edge of the bed
Same form as the push-up

units.name: 鑽石伏地挺身
tips: 雙手擺成鑽石形
難度高，做不了先用跪姿
tips_en: Put your hands together in a diamond shape
It's hard: start on your knees if you can't do it yet

units.name: 三頭伏地挺身
tips: 建議跪姿做
不要聳肩，速度要慢
tips_en: Best done on your knees
Don't shrug; go slow

units.name: 板凳臂屈伸
tips: 用沙發、凳子或床邊
身體不要離凳子太遠，肩膀壓力會太大
越慢越好；太輕鬆可在身上放重物
tips_en: Use the sofa, a bench or the edge of the bed
Keep your body close to the bench, or your shoulders take too much load
The slower the better; if it's too easy, rest a weight on your lap

d2.label: 第 2 天
d2.title: 背・肩・二頭・臀腿
d2.after_en: Afterwards, stretch the muscles you trained
d2.tableNote: 影片表格寫「Z字」,但口述與示範都是 T字(05:14),以 T字 為準

units.name: Y字
tips: 大拇指朝上
脊柱中立，不要彎腰駝背，核心收緊
沉肩：肩膀遠離耳朵
一下 3–5 秒
tips_en: Thumbs up
Neutral spine: don't round your back; brace your core
Shoulders down, away from your ears
3–5 seconds per rep

units.name: T字
tips: 大拇指朝上、脊柱中立、沉肩
做起來很輕鬆 = 動作不對
tips_en: Thumbs up, neutral spine, shoulders down
If it feels easy, your form is off

units.name: 小燕飛
tips: 做退階版
不要聳肩
下落時身體不要完全貼地，保持一點懸空
腹部收緊，頂端停 1–2 秒
tips_en: Do the easier, regressed version
Don't shrug
On the way down, don't rest on the floor; stay slightly lifted
Brace your abs and hold 1–2 seconds at the top

units.name: 俯身側平舉
tips: 可以拿兩瓶礦泉水
脊柱中立、不駝背、不聳肩
速度要慢
tips_en: Two water bottles work as weights
Neutral spine: no rounding, no shrugging
Go slow

units.name: 站姿側平舉
tips: 手臂微彎，不用完全伸直
身體不要前後晃，腹部臀部收緊
頂端停 1–2 秒
tips_en: Keep a slight bend in your elbows; no need to lock them straight
Don't rock back and forth; brace your abs and glutes
Hold 1–2 seconds at the top

units.name: 二頭彎舉
tips: 礦泉水、米袋、書包都可以
身體不晃，上臂夾緊身體兩側
做完整行程
tips_en: Water bottles, a bag of rice or a backpack all work
Keep your body still and your upper arms pinned to your sides
Use the full range of motion

units.name: 深蹲
tips: 站寬練臀多，與肩同寬練腿多
脊柱中立，不要彎腰駝背
腳尖和膝蓋方向一致
tips_en: A wide stance works the glutes more; shoulder width works the legs more
Neutral spine: don't round your back
Keep your knees in line with your toes

units.name: 保加利亞分腿蹲
tips: 後腳放凳子、沙發或床邊
距離抓到小腿和地面垂直
腳尖和膝蓋方向一致，速度要慢
tips_en: Rear foot on a bench, the sofa or the edge of the bed
Stand far enough out that your front shin is vertical
Knees in line with toes; go slow

d3.label: 第 3 天
d3.title: 腹肌核心
d3.circuitNote: 每個動作 30 秒，動作之間不休息，8 個做完算 1 輪；做 2 輪，輪間休息 3–5 分鐘

units.name: 腹肌循環 第 1 輪
腹肌循環 第 2 輪

core.name: 平板支撐
tips: 腹部、核心、臀部收緊，不塌腰
身體成一直線，肩胛骨穩定不鬆垮
tips_en: Brace your abs, core and glutes; don't let your hips sag
Body in one straight line, shoulder blades stable

core.name: 捲腹
tips: 下背不離地，只有上背離地
起來吐氣，還原吸氣，慢
tips_en: Keep your lower back on the floor; only your upper back lifts
Breathe out on the way up, in on the way down, slowly

core.name: 平板支撐
tips: 腹部、核心、臀部收緊，不塌腰
tips_en: Brace your abs, core and glutes; don't let your hips sag

core.name: V字捲腹
tips: 腳不要碰到地面
起來吐氣，還原吸氣，慢
tips_en: Don't let your feet touch the floor
Breathe out on the way up, in on the way down, slowly

core.name: 平板支撐
tips: 腹部、核心、臀部收緊，不塌腰
tips_en: Brace your abs, core and glutes; don't let your hips sag

core.name: 捲腹摸腳
tips: 全程上背保持懸空
tips_en: Keep your upper back off the floor the whole time

core.name: 平板支撐
tips: 腹部、核心、臀部收緊，不塌腰
tips_en: Brace your abs, core and glutes; don't let your hips sag

core.name: 交替抬腿
tips: 腹部收緊，雙腳輪流抬起
tips_en: Brace your abs and raise your legs one at a time
